topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Rain's been coming down all week, steady as a heartbreak. Got a call from Mrs. Henderson next door, her voice small like the whisper of a spent match. She's thinking of putting up a fence, a real sturdy one, like the kind that doesn’t just keep the elements out but the world too. I can hear the reluctance in her tone, the way she says it’s for the best, the way she asks if I think it's too much. I tell her no one can fault a person for wanting a bit of privacy, but I don’t believe my own words. This city, it eats away at the spaces between us, makes neighbors into strangers. I know a fence won’t change that, but what can I say to stop her?
